Coverage_Description: Comprehensive medical cover from prevention, diagnosis, treatment to rehabilitation; plan options cover Greater China / Global (excluding US) / Global, with eligible inpatient room classes by region; annual limit HK$5,000,000-HK$30,000,000 and lifetime limit HK$24,000,000-HK$70,000,000
customer requirement: One active policy per insured; can be bought as basic plan or as rider (rider must attach to a basic plan)
price structure: Lifetime renewable annually; premium rates are non-guaranteed and adjusted at renewal based on risk class (e.g., age, deductible, plan level, nationality/residence), cla
additional informations: Optional outpatient rider "门诊宝" (Greater China/Hong Kong/Macau) with annual limit HK$30,000; insurer may revise terms with 30 days’ prior notice before renewal; for Plan 4, renewal guarantee may cease if insured stayed in the US >=183 days in past 12 months and refuses switch to Plan 3
